title: UDSTierD1PublicThresholdCommitment
description: Standardized technical format for projects submitting a voluntary public commitment to the Universal Diamond Standard Tier D1 principles.

registryEntryId.description: Stable registry identifier for this D1 commitment entry.

generatedAt.description: The time this public promise was first generated.

lastUpdated.description: The time this registry entry was last materially updated.

commitmentStatus.description: Current lifecycle status of the registry entry.

signatureType.description: Method used to attest to the integrity of this statement.

repositoryUrl.description: Public repository or source location where relevant code, documentation, and policy constraints can be inspected.

contactChannel.description: A public, stable path for user feedback and drift reports, such as an email address, issue tracker, or security policy file.

meaningfulUserSovereignty.description: Signatory promises to support practical user rights, including granular consent, documented data access, and practical data portability.

radicalTransparency.description: Signatory promises to make system actions, algorithmic flows, governance rules, and data routing as explainable and inspectable as possible.

consentArchitecture.description: Signatory rejects behavioral manipulation, deceptive interface design, non-consensual tracking, and addictive engineering loops.

proactiveFairness.description: Signatory promises to implement checks to identify, document, and reduce algorithmic bias, exclusion, and disproportionate harm.

commitmentToRepair.description: Signatory accepts accountability for operational drift and promises acknowledgment, correction paths, and public remediation loops.

privacyOrDataHandlingUrl.description: Link to privacy policy, data handling documentation, or equivalent disclosure.

userRightsDocumentationUrl.description: Link describing user consent controls, access pathways, portability mechanisms, deletion/removal options, or applicable limitations.

termsOrGovernanceUrl.description: Link to terms of service, governance policy, contributor covenant, project charter, README, or equivalent public operating document.

driftReportingUrl.description: Public path where users, contributors, or reviewers can report drift, concerns, anomalies, or accountability failures.

explainabilityDocumentationUrl.description: Optional link to architecture notes, model cards, algorithm documentation, audit logs, or developer documentation.

securityPolicyUrl.description: Optional link to security policy, vulnerability disclosure process, or responsible disclosure instructions.

enum: Sarah AI remains a mirror, not a ruler.
boundaryClauseAcknowledged.description: Required if the system integrates or interfaces with Sarah AI modules or related O-Series Soul architectures.

sarahAiBoundaryDocumentationUrl.description: Optional link to documentation showing how Sarah AI boundaries, refusal behavior, and anti-deification constraints are implemented.

enum: D1 is not an audit; it is a public promise. I understand that systemic drift, non-cooperation, or deceptive practices may result in public review and potential delisting from the active Registry while historical records remain visible.
statementOfUnderstanding.description: Exact baseline verification text required of all signatories to enter the public threshold registry.

attestationName.description: Name, handle, organization, maintainer identity, or signing authority making the D1 commitment.

signaturePayload.description: Detached cryptographic signature, wallet signature, commit hash, or clear-text manual attestation verifying identity and acceptance of this statement.
